nodes.description: Mapping of token balances per address in ERC20.
Nested mapping of owner=>spender=>allowance in ERC20.
Total token supply tracked in ERC20.
Token name string set in ERC20 constructor.
Token symbol string set in ERC20 constructor.
Generator version string set in GeneratorCopyright constructor.
ERC20 transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) forwarding to _transfer with _msgSender().
ERC20 approve(address spender, uint256 amount) forwarding to _approve.
ERC20 transferFrom that moves tokens and reduces allowance of _msgSender().
ERC20 increaseAllowance that adds addedValue to current allowance.
ERC20 decreaseAllowance that subtracts subtractedValue from current allowance.
Internal _transfer that validates addresses/balance and mutates _balances then emits Transfer.
Internal _mint that increases _totalSupply and credits _balances[account].
Internal _burn that decreases balance and _totalSupply.
Internal _approve that writes _allowances[owner][spender] and emits Approval.
ServicePayer payable constructor performing an external payable call to IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName).
SimpleERC20 payable constructor that validates initialBalance_ and mints the whole supply to _msgSender().
msg.sender, caller-controlled address that becomes the initial token holder.
External payable call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) executed in ServicePayer constructor.
Constructor parameter name_ (token name).
Constructor parameter symbol_ (token symbol).
Constructor parameter initialBalance_ (amount minted to deployer).
Constructor parameter feeReceiver_ (payable address receiving the service fee).
ServicePayer constructor parameter receiver (payable target of the external call).
ServicePayer constructor parameter serviceName (string passed to the external call).
Parameter recipient of ERC20.transfer.
Parameter amount of ERC20.transfer.
Parameter sender of ERC20.transferFrom.
Parameter recipient of ERC20.transferFrom.
Parameter amount of ERC20.transferFrom.
Parameter spender of ERC20.approve.
Parameter amount of ERC20.approve.
Local variable senderBalance in ERC20._transfer.
Local variable currentAllowance in ERC20.transferFrom.
Local variable accountBalance in ERC20._burn.

edges.reason: name_ flows into the SimpleERC20 constructor and onward to ERC20 storage.
symbol_ flows into the SimpleERC20 constructor and onward to ERC20 storage.
initialBalance_ is validated inside the SimpleERC20 constructor.
initialBalance_ is passed as the amount argument of _mint.
msg.sender determines the token holder created by the constructor.
msg.sender is used as the account argument of _mint, receiving the entire supply.
feeReceiver_ is forwarded to the ServicePayer base constructor.
receiver is stored as the payment target in the ServicePayer constructor.
serviceName is used as the argument of the external pay call.
receiver is the externally controlled contract invoked with value in the external call.
The ServicePayer constructor executes the external payable call pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName).
The SimpleERC20 constructor invokes the ServicePayer payable base constructor which performs an external call.
The SimpleERC20 constructor calls _mint(_msgSender(), initialBalance_).
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer before adjusting the allowance.
transferFrom calls _approve to write the reduced allowance.
approve delegates to _approve.
increaseAllowance calls _approve with the summed value.
decreaseAllowance calls _approve with the reduced value.
_transfer reads and writes _balances for sender and recipient.
_mint credits _balances[account].
_mint performs _totalSupply += amount.
_burn debits _balances[account].
_burn performs _totalSupply -= amount.
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender].
senderBalance local is read from _balances and subtracted by amount inside _transfer.
currentAllowance local is read from _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] and reduced by amount.
accountBalance local is read from _balances[account] and subtracted in _burn.
recipient parameter flows into ERC20.transfer and then into _transfer.
amount parameter flows into ERC20.transfer and then into _transfer.
sender parameter flows into ERC20.transferFrom and then into _transfer.
recipient parameter flows into ERC20.transferFrom and then into _transfer.
amount parameter flows into ERC20.transferFrom and is compared/subtracted from the allowance.
spender parameter flows into ERC20.approve and then into _approve.
amount parameter flows into ERC20.approve and becomes the recorded allowance.

normalization_plan.reason: name_ is a constructor parameter only meaningful inside the SimpleERC20 constructor.
symbol_ is a constructor parameter only meaningful inside the SimpleERC20 constructor.
initialBalance_ is validated and consumed by the SimpleERC20 constructor.
feeReceiver_ is forwarded to and used by the ServicePayer constructor.
receiver is used as the payment target inside the ServicePayer constructor.
serviceName is consumed by the external call inside the ServicePayer constructor.
senderBalance is a temporary local inside ERC20._transfer.
currentAllowance is a temporary local inside ERC20.transferFrom.
accountBalance is a temporary local inside ERC20._burn.
